name: Iso-kun
source:
A mysterious being that appeared out of nowhere in the room at the back of the pool.
Because it looks just like a sea anemone, Airi arbitrarily named it "Iso-kun."
It is unknown whether it has any connection to Mariposa, the pharmaceutical company that recently had an accident.
